name: Notre Dame
hook: One name for a Paris cathedral and an Indiana university — and Jeopardy asks about both.

facts.label: the University of Notre Dame
facts.statement: French Catholic missionaries led by Father Edward Sorin founded the University of Notre Dame in Indiana in 1842.

facts.label: Knute Rockne
facts.statement: Knute Rockne coached Notre Dame football from 1918 to 1930 with the best career winning percentage, .881.

facts.label: the Four Horsemen
facts.statement: Notre Dame's 1924 backfield was the Four Horsemen: Stuhldreher, Crowley, Miller and Layden.

facts.label: Rudy
facts.statement: Rudy is the 1993 film about a Notre Dame dreamer; it was the first film pairing Jon Favreau and Vince Vaughn.

facts.label: South Bend, Indiana
facts.statement: Notre Dame sits near South Bend, Indiana, once home to the Studebaker automobile company.

facts.label: the Paris cathedral
facts.statement: Victor Hugo's The Hunchback of Notre Dame, with the bell ringer Quasimodo and gypsy Esmeralda, spurred Paris to save the cathedral.

facts.label: the Seine
facts.statement: The Seine runs past Notre Dame in Paris; in January 2018 flooding closed the cathedral as the river peaked.
